scheme_data.description: QCD corrections in the MG5 loop_sm-no_b_mass model: alpha=1/aEWM1 fixed with Gf and MZ (MW derived at tree level), stable top, massless b/tau/light fermions, all widths zero, five-flavour alpha_s renormalization with decoupled top, six quark flavours in loops, Feynman gauge.

normalization.convention: |A_loop|^2 summed over final and averaged over initial helicities and colours, with the final identical-particle factor; physical couplings

point_construction.construction: tools/loop_reference/exact_points.py: deterministic exact terminating-decimal sequential construction; mass shells and momentum conservation exact

rule: PLAN §4.0 L1: provider agreement <= 1e-05 relative (lax); digits recorded

madloop.timing_scope: single thread pinned; untimed warm-up (MadLoop: past its initialisation), then each point timed once; not a benchmark campaign

fortran_flags.source: MG5_aMC run-card defaults global_flag/aloha_flag/matrix_flag (CommonRunCmd.update_make_opts of an optimised MG5 run); MadLoop's own makefile adds -O3 for polynomial.f

mg5_quadruple_precision_model_function_r: added KIND=16 to 19 CMPLX calls in MP_ functions
settings.warm_up: untimed calls cycling through the points until MadLoop leaves its initialisation phase, at least CheckCycle + 1 = 4
